dataset_overlap_with_ecgfounder_training: PTB-XL (Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt, Berlin; Schiller devices, 1989-1996) is not part of ECGFounder's pretraining data (Harvard-Emory ECG Database, MGH + Emory). The official repository uses PTB-XL as an external validation set for the 150-class head (ptbxl_eval.py, csv/ptbxl_label.csv) and the paper uses it for downstream experiments. Released 150-class weights are therefore not expected to have been trained on these labels, but thresholds published by the authors were tuned on PTB-XL and are not reused.
